cards.t: Avengers: Endgame becomes the biggest film ever
h: Endgame came out in the years just before the pandemic.
Endgame hit cinemas the year before COVID-19 was declared a pandemic.
Endgame

cards.fact: A pixel art cat with a Pop Tart body trailed rainbows across the internet.
h: Nyan Cat flew across screens in the early days of YouTube memes.
Nyan Cat appeared the same year Minecraft was fully released.
Nyan Cat
The Nintendo 64 arrived in the decade of dial up internet.
The N64 launched the same year the Spice Girls released Wannabe.
The Nintendo 64

cards.t: The first text message is sent
h: The first text message was sent when mobile phones were still the size of bricks.
The first text message was sent the year after the World Wide Web opened to the public.
The first text message
Machu Picchu was built at the height of the Inca Empire.
Machu Picchu was built less than a century before the Spanish conquered the Inca.
Machu Picchu

cards.t: Genghis Khan founds the Mongol Empire
h: Genghis Khan rose in the age of the Crusades.
Genghis Khan founded his empire nine years before Magna Carta.
The Mongol Empire

cards.t: The last woolly mammoths die out
cards.fact: Mammoths outlived the building of the Great Pyramid by roughly 900 years, hanging on until about 1650 BC on Wrangel Island in the Arctic.
h: The last mammoths lived on into the Bronze Age, on a remote Arctic island.
Woolly mammoths were still alive when Egypt's pyramids were already ancient.
The last mammoths

cards.t: The Great Pyramid of Giza is completed
h: The Great Pyramid rose in the Bronze Age, during Egypt's Old Kingdom.
The Great Pyramid was built for the pharaoh Khufu, more than 4,500 years ago.
The Great Pyramid
